صَلَعٌ Baldness in the fore part of the head: (S, O, Msb, K:) or in the fore part of the head to the hinder part thereof: and likewise in the middle of the head. (TA. [See صَلِعَ, of which it is the inf. n.: and see also جَلَحٌ.]) ―
-b2- Also a dial. var. of صُلَّعٌ, q. v. (TA.) ―
-b3- One says also, لَأُقِيمَنَّ صَلَعَكَ meaning [I will assuredly straighten] thy [natural] crookedness; like ضَلَعَكَ. (TA in art. ضلع, from the T and M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
